ideas.pitch: An interactive execution trace visualizer specifically tailored for competitive programming test cases, stepping through memory and variable states line by line.
ideas.title: AlgoTrace Visualizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the core theme of ELUCode-4 by helping coders debug complex algorithmic logic failures in real-time.

ideas.pitch: A smart edge-case generator that ingests a problem statement and automatically outputs adversarial test cases to break naive competitive programming solutions.
ideas.title: CP-Testcase-Gen
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages algorithmic thinking and test-case generation, which aligns closely with how ELUCode evaluates code efficiency and correctness.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight static analysis tool that estimates the time and space complexity of submitted code before running it against hidden test cases.
ideas.title: Complexity-Oracle
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the specific scoring criteria of ELUCode which heavily rewards efficiency and optimization on hidden test suites.

ideas.pitch: A minimalist head-to-head competitive coding platform where single players solve mini algorithmic puzzles against an AI bot with adjustable time limits.
ideas.title: DuelCode Arena
ideas.why_it_could_win: Emulates the fast-paced, competitive spirit of EduLinkUp's challenge structure with interactive gamification.

ideas.pitch: A smart snippet manager for competitive programmers that auto-indexes data structure implementations and graph algorithms for instant retrieval during contests.
ideas.title: SnippetVault CP
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides a practical, productivity-boosting tool tailored directly to the fast-paced 2-hour format of EduLinkUp coding contests.
